card.name: Capital W or Z starting a word
card.fires_on: A bare capital W or Z that begins a word split into pieces, mostly the W of 'Warnings' after '[see' in cross-references. Also W or Z opening a surname in citations or name lists.

modes.label: Warnings cross-reference
modes.description: The W starting 'Warnings and Precautions' after 'see' inside brackets.

modes.label: Names and citations
modes.description: A capital W or Z beginning a surname or acronym in references or author lists.

card.plain: It fires on a lone capital W or Z that starts a word, most often the W of 'Warnings' in a '[see Warnings and Precautions' reference.
